## Summary

Describe the public engineering change.

## Checklist

- [ ] No credentials, account data, or private datasets are included.
- [ ] No non-public strategy logic, parameters, execution behavior, or research history is disclosed.
- [ ] Logs and screenshots use synthetic or public data only.
- [ ] Image metadata is stripped.
- [ ] README, comments, file names, commit messages, and branch names stay generic.
- [ ] Tests and lint checks pass.
